nodes.label: Patrón Facade
nodes.rationale: Single entry point hiding EF Core + Strategy + business rules; changing the ORM or queries does not affect controllers.

nodes.label: Patrón MVC
nodes.rationale: No controller talks to CalorixDbContext directly; all go through ICalorixFacade.

nodes.label: Patrón Singleton
nodes.rationale: DatabaseConnection has a private constructor and static Instance property; Initialize is called once in Program.cs.

nodes.label: Patrón Strategy (fórmulas calóricas intercambiables)
nodes.rationale: Formula chosen from URL (?formula=mifflin); CalculadorNutricional context can swap strategy at runtime via CambiarEstrategia(). Mifflin-St Jeor recommended/modern, Harris-Benedict classic 1919, Deportiva = Katch-McArdle for athletes.

nodes.label: Listas serializadas JSON (PacienteIds, AlimentoIds)
nodes.rationale: Deliberate denormalization via HasConversion + JsonSerializer to speed up patient/nutritionist membership and meal components instead of explicit join tables.

nodes.label: Snapshot nutricional en RegistroComida
nodes.rationale: Macros are stored at registration time so historical records keep original values if the Alimentos table changes.
